articles.title: Did You Know Ice Cream Has a Whole Month Just for It?
articles.summary: July is National Ice Cream Month in the U.S., a tradition started by President Reagan in 1984. Americans eat about 23 pounds of ice cream per person each year, and California makes the most!

articles.title: BTS Says 'No Thanks' to the Grammys This Year
articles.summary: BTS won't send their new album 'ARIRANG' to the 2027 Grammy Awards. The group says they want their music to be loved for itself, not put into boxes by language or region.

articles.title: These Tiny Fish Are Real-Life Rock Climbers!
articles.summary: Scientists have proof that shellear fish in Africa can climb steep, wet rock walls — even up 50-foot waterfalls! They use tiny hooks on their fins like Velcro to grip the rocks.
